title: The Ant and the Grasshopper: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: At the start of the story, it was a cold winter day.
The grasshopper sang and played all day.
The ant was collecting food for winter.
The ant worked only when she was not tired.
In autumn, the grasshopper had saved a lot of food.
In winter, snow covered the ground.
Where did the ant walk back and forth?
options: Between the field and her home
Between the river and the forest
items.why: “She walked back and forth between the field and her home.”

items.q: What did the grasshopper say about winter?
What filled the ant's little storehouse?
items.why: “Slowly, her little storehouse filled with food.”

items.q: What colors did the leaves turn?
items.why: “The leaves turned yellow, orange, and red.”

items.q: What did the grasshopper ask the ant in winter?
options: If she could sing with him
If she had any food to share
items.why: "Do you have any food to share?"

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: All summer, the ant worked hard and collected food for winter, but the grasshopper only sang and played. When winter came, the grasshopper had no food and was cold and hungry. He understood that he should have prepared while food was plentiful.

items.q: Why didn't the ant play with the grasshopper?
items.model: She was collecting food for winter.

items.q: What was winter like for the grasshopper?
items.model: Snow covered the ground. There were no green leaves and no seeds to eat, so he was cold and hungry.
He should have prepared while food was plentiful. After that, he remembered to work before hard times came.

items.q: What do you do today to be ready for tomorrow?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: The grasshopper asked the ant to play
The ant's storehouse filled with food
The leaves turned yellow, orange and red
The grasshopper went to the ant's home
